meaning: Import AtomisticCausalSource.source on the existing actualGraph m w, using the actual subtype with the order inherited from the SAME ambient PartialOrder B. Its chosen source s is actual by subtype membership. If s had no ambient necessary parts, CF3 would give an incoming cause; CF4 makes that cause actual, contradicting the imported actualSource_iff characterization. Supplied EM therefore yields p ≤ s with NecessaryAt m w p. The selected-world actual-parts policy makes p actually exist. Conclude the EXISTING NecessaryBeing endpoint for p, not necessity of s. The part may equal s; no properness, distinctness or outgoing role follows. No activity, LocalCausalPrinciple, reflexive accessibility, global WF, no-necessary-parts cover, concreteness or full author first-cause conclusion is assumed or inferred. The complete-production interpretation and all three one-world policy applications remain OPEN.

strong_version_needed.b699ecfb-08f7-5864-a671-1205c8f5792f: The old source-consumer needs actuality of a causer of its selected actualGraph source, whose identity is obtained from the atomistic source theorem.
